Abhijit Dipke threatens fresh protests over student harassment and paper leaks

Abhijit Dipke, founder of CJP, has threatened to launch large-scale peaceful protests if the government does not address issues of student harassment and alleged paper leaks. Dipke stated that he would soon announce their strategy. He also accused Home Minister Amit Shah of ordering police action against students on July 20 and supported Rahul Gandhi's demand for Shah's resignation. Dipke expressed concern over a Supreme Court order and questioned the roles of democracy, the judiciary, and the Delhi Police.
